title: KitCatalogV1
description:
The minimum a release catalog must carry for the generic CLI to read it. Transcribed from the view the CLI consumes: KitCatalogView and KitCatalogRelease in spfn packages/cli/src/kit/ports.ts, read by readCatalog and used by latestActiveRelease.

Unlike every other contract in this set, this one is open rather than closed. It describes a generic view of a larger signed catalog snapshot, not the whole document — a real snapshot also carries channel, issuance and expiry fields, and each release carries a manifest digest. Setting additionalProperties false here would reject the very documents the contract exists to describe, so the schema states a floor and leaves the rest to the snapshot's own contract.

kitId.description: Which Kit this catalog is for. The CLI is generic, so this is a public ID rather than a fixed value.

sequence.description: Monotonic catalog sequence. The CLI tolerates its absence by defaulting to 0, but a producer has to emit it: without it a client cannot refuse an older snapshot replayed at it.

status.description: Unit 05 section 2.2, which is the approved source: active means a new install, update or rebuild may take it; superseded means it is no longer recommended automatically but an entitled client may still rebuild that exact version; revoked blocks new metadata and tarball acquisition. Selecting the latest release picks the newest active one, so a superseded release stays reachable by exact version but is never chosen on its own. Wave 1 shipped a temporary stable/revoked pair before unit 05 was consulted; I0-C3 retired it.
